# Yue

Yue keeps the UI palette subtle while making syntax highlighting vibrant in both light and dark modes. Its recorded description lists a mobile quick-preview and edit FAB, customizable text and highlighter colours, line numbers in code blocks, tag pills, styled image cards, several checkbox icon types, and JetBrains Mono with ligatures.

![Yue screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gixoxyz/YueObsidian/HEAD/assets/main-demo.png)
